name: Media Photos Auto-Scroll
description: MPAS is Google Chrome extension that automatically scrolls through Facebook galleries/pages to the bottom, allowing the user to browse passively while multitasking. It bypasses Facebook's native scroll-blocking (which throttles or resets standard programmatic scrolling) by simulating human-like scroll behavior — dynamic, variable-speed scrolling combined with background image preloading (forcing lazy-loaded images to render ahead of the visible viewport) to avoid triggering Facebook's anti-bot detection.
